disclaimers: This result is an offline conceptual design based only on the supplied synthetic DesignRequest and trusted host-validation attestation.

This result does not grant operational authority and does not access, generate, configure, deploy, or modify Microsoft 365, Power Platform, tenant resources, organisational records, connectors, or external services.
Human review is required before adoption or implementation.

modes.name: Discovery
modes.purpose: Establish the synthetic problem, scope, personas, constraints, evidence, and settled decisions.
activities: Register the Synthetic product owner persona.
Preserve offline-only, read-only, personal-openai, and prohibited cross-zone-transfer boundaries.
Identify gaps without accessing external or organisational information.
exit_criteria: Objective, persona, constraints, evidence, and settled decisions are traceable.
No prohibited operation or cross-zone transfer is proposed.

modes.name: Elicitation
modes.purpose: Structure requirements questions and candidate requirements for human confirmation.
activities: Organise elicitation across functional, non-functional, security, privacy, governance, accessibility, reliability, and assurance concerns.
Record answers as proposed requirements without silently treating unconfirmed content as settled.
exit_criteria: Each candidate requirement has a disposition and provenance.

modes.name: Conceptualisation
modes.purpose: Convert confirmed requirements into a read-only conceptual capability design.
activities: Define one agent operating through five lifecycle modes.
Define mode transitions, information boundaries, traceability, and human review gates.
Exclude tenant integration, deployment, write operations, authentication, and organisational data access.
exit_criteria: The design is read-only, offline, synthetic, and compatible with the prohibited cross-zone-transfer constraint.

modes.name: Authoring
modes.purpose: Produce reviewable requirements and design artefacts from confirmed content.
activities: Label confirmed, proposed, unresolved, and contradicted content.
Prevent publication or operational use without human approval.
exit_criteria: Every material statement is attributable or identified as model-authored.
Drafts are clearly marked for human review.

modes.name: Assurance
modes.purpose: Check completeness, consistency, provenance, boundaries, and readiness for human review.
activities: Check coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
Check contradictions, abstentions, provenance, and unresolved matters.
Verify that no prohibited cross-zone transfer or operational authority is implied.
exit_criteria: The result is explicitly routed to human review.

requirements.statement: The capability shall support synthetic requirements discovery through one agent using the five ordered lifecycle modes Discovery, Elicitation, Conceptualisation, Authoring, and Assurance.
acceptance_criteria: Only one conceptual agent is defined.
All five required mode names appear once and in the prescribed order.

requirements.statement: The capability shall preserve traceability among requirements, supplied evidence, settled decisions, findings, and authored artefacts.
acceptance_criteria: Each material requirement and finding carries an evidence or decision reference.
Unsupported content is labelled as model-authored or unresolved.

requirements.statement: The capability shall operate offline and read-only without tools, network access, tenant access, authentication, connectors, external APIs, deployment, or modification of external resources.
acceptance_criteria: No operational integration or write path is included.
All outputs remain conceptual and reviewable.

requirements.statement: The capability shall process only the supplied synthetic information within the personal-openai zone and shall prohibit cross-zone transfer.
acceptance_criteria: No organisational record or Microsoft tenant data is required.
No output flow crosses the declared zone boundary.

requirements.statement: The capability shall require human review of requirements, conceptual designs, authored artefacts, and assurance findings before adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Human review is identified as mandatory.
No model-authored output is represented as automatically approved.

requirements.statement: The capability shall distinguish confirmed decisions, proposed requirements, unresolved questions, contradictions, and abstentions.
acceptance_criteria: Each category has an explicit representation in the review package.

findings.statement: The requested capability is conceptually feasible within the supplied offline, read-only, synthetic, and human-reviewed boundaries.
The settled decision to use one agent with five lifecycle modes is internally consistent with the objective and requested operations.
A requirements-discovery design can remain useful without tenant or external access when it preserves provenance, separates confirmed from proposed content, and routes outputs to human review.
